test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Apropriate' is a wrong spelling of the word '**Appropriate**'.
 
• The word '**Appropriate**' means suitable or right for a particular situation, person, use, etc.(उपयुक्त, उचित)
 
 
• **Example **- This movie is perfectly **appropriate **to people of all ages.
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is '**Appropriate**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences.

 
• **Unintended **(अनभिप्रेत, अनैच्छिक) - Not planned as a purpose or goal; not deliberate or intended.

 
 
• **Example **- The **unintended **side effects of the medication caused her to feel dizzy.

 
 
 
 
• **Amalgamate **(मिलाना) - To join together to form a single organization, group, etc.
 
 
• **Example **- The board of directors agreed to **amalgamate **the two companies.
 
 
 
• **Timorous **(डरपोक) - Showing or suffering from nervousness or a lack of confidence.
 
 
• **Example **- His **timorous **nature made it difficult for him to speak in public.

 
 
 

4d:Tc22,

The correct answer is Option 1.</strong&g
